sk.overview: Powerica operates across two industries: (1) India's standby power / diesel-generator (DG set) market, where DG sets, UPS, inverters and battery storage provide backup power during outages/voltage fluctuations across commercial, manufacturing, IT/data-centre, telecom and infrastructure sectors (F&S Report); and (2) India's wind power sector within the broader renewable energy industry, where wind plays a pivotal role in the country's energy transition (CRISIL Report).
sk.schemes: SECI wind auctions (Tranche-XVII)|GUVNL state wind auctions (Phase X)|Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme|Make in India|Semiconductor initiatives
sk.structure: DG sets classified by capacity: LHP (7.5-160 kVA), MHP (180-500 kVA), HHP (>500 kVA); MSLG sets 3-10 MW for continuous/base-load. Wind potential concentrated in five states: Rajasthan (24%), Gujarat (16%), Maharashtra (15%), Karnataka (15%), Andhra Pradesh (11%).

risks.body:

- Volatility in the availability and pricing of key components may impact project timelines and profitability.
- Delays arising from land acquisition, permitting, financing constraints, transmission connectivity, or contractor-related issues may affect project timelines and profitability.
- Fluctuations in financing costs may impact project timelines and profitability.
- Growing demand for experienced technical professionals in renewable energy and electrical engineering may lead to talent shortages and increased employee costs.
- Rising frequency of floods, heatwaves, cyclones, and storms may disrupt manufacturing operations, supply chains, and project execution.
- Frequent changes in industry standards and certification requirements may necessitate product redesign, additional testing, and higher compliance costs.
- The solar EPC industry operates in a dynamic environment with evolving regulatory frameworks, competitive market conditions, and changing customer expectations, requiring continuous innovation and investment to remain competitive.
